description.value: Pho 11 is a family-owned Vietnamese restaurant tucked into the Woodgrove Mall food court in Nanaimo, serving authentic pho, banh mi subs, rice and vermicelli bowls, and fresh salad rolls. The kitchen emphasizes locally sourced, seasonal ingredients and caters explicitly to gluten-free and vegan diners with dedicated menus. It also offers online ordering and third-party delivery through DoorDash, Skip The Dishes, and Uber Eats.

address.value: Woodgrove Mall Food Court, Nanaimo, BC
